**golden.json could not be read.** No golden.json path was supplied with this run, and this arm has no read tool: the only surfaces available are the graphify MCP tools plus `Write`, and `ToolSearch {"query":"select:Read,Glob"}` returned "No matching deferred tools found". So I cannot print the gold file list, nor the found/missed split. That comparison is unavailable for this arm — not skipped by choice.

What PHASE 1 concluded, for the harness to diff against gold by hand:

- **Infers presence from truthiness (symptom sites):** `query` — `packages/query-core/src/queriesObserver.ts` (the app-supplied `combine` result cached behind a falsy-check, so an empty combined result re-runs `combine` every pass) and `packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts` (an app-supplied `select` that throws an empty value leaves the select-error falsy, so the observer never reports `status: 'error'` and continues down the success path). Secondary candidate carried in the answer: `redux-toolkit` `packages/toolkit/src/query/core/buildThunks.ts` (`result.error` from a user baseQuery tested for truthiness before wrapping).
- **Owns the presence-is-not-value contract:** `react` `compiler/packages/babel-plugin-react-compiler/src/Utils/Result.ts` (the tagged pair — `isOk`/`isErr` read the tag, never the payload) and `db` `packages/db/src/utils/comparison.ts` (`isUnorderable()` enumerating the values with no natural ordering). Plus the flag/tag/wrapper/status exemplars: `reselect/src/weakMapMemoize.ts` (terminated/unterminated cache-node status) and `src/utils.ts` (`NOT_FOUND` sentinel), `redux-toolkit/packages/toolkit/src/query/HandledError.ts` (wrapper), `react-redux/src/connect/selectorFactory.ts` (first-call flag), `tldraw/packages/state/src/lib/Computed.ts` (`UNINITIALIZED`), `jotai/src/vanilla/internals.ts` (presence by key, not value).
